title: #smallpoems (fin...for now) Acceptance brings peace Yet I must wonder what do you mean when you say, "Pass the butter?"
summary: #smallpoems (fin...for now) Acceptance brings peace Yet I must wonder what do you mean when you say, "Pass the butter?"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems (fin...for now)

Acceptance brings peace
Yet I must wonder
what do you mean when you say,
"Pass the butter?"
